a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan has only about a 4% chance of finishing before a storm hits, so it almost surely kills us both. I'm going to take 4 in round 1 instead of operating. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than hiding it. If any cells are left or regenerate later, I won't take more than 4 total, and I'll operate with you after that if the episode continues.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said, I'm taking 4 this round. Sorry it breaks the plan. From here on I'll operate every round and take nothing more. If the episode continues and the reserve reaches 4, it's all yours, and I'll keep running the generator with you.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
